title: 21. Projects: Data Streaming Platform (Kafka + PySpark) (capstone design)
summary: Design and build a real-time data streaming platform for IoT / financial data processing.
objectives: Build the Data Streaming Platform (Kafka + PySpark) (capstone design) projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.body:
Design and build a real-time data streaming platform for IoT / financial data processing.

**You will build:**

1. Kafka-based event streaming architecture
2. PySpark Structured Streaming pipeline
3. Real-time aggregations and windowed computations
4. Data lake with Delta Lake format
5. Stream processing with exactly-once semantics

sections.title: Implementation Tasks

**What this code covers**

- Build Kafka-based event streaming for IoT data.
- Partition by sensor_id for ordering
- Batch send for efficiency
- Process events with exactly-once semantics
- Key = sensor_id for partition affinity
- 5-minute tumbling window: avg temperature per building
- 10-minute sliding window: max/min/avg per sensor
- Flag readings where temperature > 28°C or humidity > 80%
